text:
Ana: Hey team — PR #8342 is ready: migration guide v2->v3 with SDK examples and a small CLI section. Need one docs reviewer + one SDK snippet reviewer. CI preview shows linkcheck failures. Can someone pick this up today? :wave:

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/8342 — Linkchecker failed: 3 broken links (docs/migration.md#old-api, sdk/python/usage.md#auth, examples/cli.md#install).

Kevin: I can take SDK snippets (python + go). Free after 14:00 PT. If urgent I can do a quick scan now. :+1:

Raj: I can check runtime correctness and async examples. Quick FYI — the python snippet in the PR will block in an aio loop, e.g.:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="...")
resp = client.chat.create(model='rwd/gpt-3', messages=[...])
print(resp.text)
```
should be:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async with AsyncClient(api_key="...") as client:
    resp = await client.chat.create(...)
    print(resp.text)
```

Sophia: We're thin on rotation today (Olga on PTO). Suggest pairing Kevin + Raj as reviewers so we cover both formatting and correctness, then a docs pass for voice/clarity. @Olga if you can quick-glance the link list that helps. :eyes:

Olga: I'm on a flight but can glance at the broken-link list in ~30m, won't be able to do a full review. If you assign me a single file I can check the link targets.

Ana: Sounds good. Assigning Kevin and Raj as reviewers + tag `docs-review`. Kevin focus on snippet formatting and callouts; Raj on async/correctness and API names. I'll fix the 3 broken links and rebase. Priority: p2. (reaction :thumbsup:)

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed (3) -> files: docs/migration.md, sdk/python/usage.md, examples/cli.md. Preview re-run scheduled.

Kevin: ACK. Starting snippet pass now — will open a tiny follow-up PR to fix code fence lang hints and a long line in the go example if needed.

Raj: Quick note — in the go example we currently call `client.Generate` but the runtime API is `client.Completions.Create`. I'll push a suggested commit to the PR branch.

Sophia: Also add a short "What changed" note at the top of the migration guide with a compact mapping table of old->new calls. Helps support triage and reduces noisy questions.

Ana: Done — added the mapping table and a 3-line "what changed" blurb in a follow-up commit and pushed. Re-running preview now.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/8342 — linkcheck passed ✅

Kevin: LGTM for snippets after my tiny follow-up. Left two minor nits about line-wrapping in code blocks (non-blocking). :thumbsup:

Raj: Code correctness LGTM after my commit. No blocking issues left.

Ana: Thanks everyone — assigning to @Sophia for final docs merge approval when you have a free minute.

Sophia: Will merge after lunch (around 12:30 PT). If someone needs it sooner ping me.

Kevin: If you want a fast merge before lunch I can cut a docs-only commit with the fixes and label it `merge-now` so it can go through the smaller approval flow.

Sophia: If Kevin makes a docs-only PR with just the two small formatting fixes I'll merge that quickly. Otherwise will merge full PR after lunch.

Ana: OK I'll coordinate — thanks all! :party_popper:
